summary_en: Ordinary dividend 77 yen/share + special dividend 30 yen/share = 107 yen/share total for FY5/26 (record date 31 May 2026, effective 31 August 2026). Total payout 272 million yen. Special dividend marks Yamashita Yakui subsidiary's 100th anniversary. Ordinary dividend above prior-year 75 yen/share; earnings exceeded guidance.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend from surplus (implementation of commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On 13 July 2026, Yamashita Health Care Holdings resolved to pay a dividend of 107 yen per share for the fiscal year ending 31 May 2026 (record date 31 May 2026, effective 31 August 2026), comprising 77 yen ordinary dividend and 30 yen special (commemorative) dividend. Total payout is 272 million yen from retained earnings.

The ordinary dividend of 77 yen exceeds the prior-year 75 yen per share and reflects earnings that exceeded published guidance. The company maintains a base payout policy targeting a consolidated payout ratio of 30% while strengthening financial position. The special 30 yen dividend commemorates the 100th anniversary of Yamashita Yakui (山下医科器械), a core subsidiary, scheduled for August 2026. The company will submit the full dividend to shareholders for approval at the ordinary general meeting on 28 August 2026.
